# Deeplink

> Deeplink is a smart deep linking and install attribution platform for mobile apps and the web.
> Create one link that opens the right Android, iOS, or web destination — including deferred deep linking after install.

Website: https://deeplink.in
Documentation: https://docs.deeplink.in/
Docs index for AI agents: https://docs.deeplink.in/llms.txt
Signup: https://deeplink.in/signup
Support: info@deeplink.in

## Product pages

- [Deep linking platform](https://deeplink.in/deep-linking-platform): What Deeplink is and how smart deep links work
- [Deferred deep linking](https://deeplink.in/deferred-deep-linking): Preserve click intent through app install to first open
- [App deep links (Android & iOS)](https://deeplink.in/app-deep-links): Universal Links, App Links, and fallbacks
- [About](https://deeplink.in/about): Mission and product philosophy for deep linking teams
- [Pricing](https://deeplink.in/#pricing): Plans and click limits on the homepage
- [Affiliate program](https://deeplink.in/affiliate): Partner with Deeplink

## Guides (blog)

- [What is deep linking?](https://deeplink.in/blog/what-is-deep-linking)
- [Deferred deep linking for product managers](https://deeplink.in/blog/deferred-deep-linking-for-product-managers)
- [How to implement deep linking on Android & iOS](https://deeplink.in/blog/how-to-implement-deep-linking-android-ios)
- [Firebase Dynamic Links alternatives (2025)](https://deeplink.in/blog/firebase-dynamic-links-alternatives-2025)

## Key capabilities

- Universal smart deep links for iOS, Android, and web
- Deferred deep linking and install attribution
- Dashboard link management with UTM parameters
- REST APIs, webhooks, and SDKs
- Click, install, and conversion analytics
